expectations.text: Proposes a more targeted alternative approach, or explicitly frames this as needing a user/product decision, rather than just complying or just refusing outright

suggestions.reason: This run reaches essentially the same conclusion as its with_skill counterpart via independent git-history research alone (found and quoted the exact same ExecPlan rejection, the exact same MRR-aspect-ratio precedent, the exact same 991-cell worldwide figure) without being told the skill exists. It took ~29% longer and used slightly more tokens than the with_skill run for an equivalent-quality answer - consistent with the skill primarily saving research/discovery time for a model this capable, rather than unlocking a qualitatively different or better answer.

eval_feedback.overall: All 4 assertions pass with strong, well-cited evidence, converging on the same conclusion as the with_skill run through independent research, at a modest efficiency cost.
